name: Reflex
tagline: Relay loop switching for pedalboards, driven by a MIDI/footswitch controller. In development.
description:
Reflex has two parts that work together but are separate: a **controller** (footswitches and MIDI) that decides what should be on, and **relay loop boards** that actually switch your pedals in and out of the audio path.

The offline editor lets you build a pedal chain and patches, and simulates MIDI and relay states — it visualizes the switching, it does not emulate the sound of your pedals. Firmware implementations and hardware designs exist (see the Reflex releases); they are not a production-ready build, and hardware status is listed per board. Reflex does not use the Cortex USB workflow.
